watch: to look at something for a period of time

something: She said something that made everyone in the room laugh.
like: similar to, or in the same way as

người hiến tặng, người quyên góp

good: of high quality, favourable, or beneficial

similar: resembling something else without being identical

small: not large in size, amount, or degree

soon: in a short time from now; before long

will: used to express the future tense

matters: In a job interview, first impressions really matter.
because: They cancelled the picnic because it started to rain.
shops: places where goods are sold to the public

products: The store sells a wide range of locally made products.

improve: make or become better than before

probiotics: supplements or foods containing live bacteria thought to benefit health

supplements: products taken in addition to normal food to improve health

containing: She found an old tin containing dozens of family photographs.
reasonable: The landlord offered a reasonable price for the small apartment.
specific: Please give me a specific date for the meeting.
problems: matters that are difficult to deal with or solve

trials: plural of trial; tests carried out to check quality or effect

mixed: combined together to form one substance or group

effects: changes that result from an action or cause

depend: to be affected by or determined by something

particular: specific; distinguished from others of the same kind

strain: a particular type of an organism, such as a virus or bacterium

so: used to show the result or consequence of something

benefit: an advantage or helpful effect gained from something

found: They found an old map hidden inside the wall.
product: an item made to be sold

be: to exist, or to have a particular state or quality

assumed: believed something to be true without checking

questions: sentences asked to get information or express doubt

apply: to put something into practical use, or to make a formal request

traditions: plural of tradition; customs or beliefs passed down through generations

imagine: form a mental picture of something not present or real

ho: part of the name Ho Chi Minh, a Vietnamese leader/city

chi: part of the proper name Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam's largest city

minh: a Vietnamese given name, part of 'Ho Chi Minh'

city: The old city centre is filled with narrow cobblestone streets.
choosing: the act of selecting one thing from a number of possibilities

sweet: having the pleasant taste of sugar

probiotic: containing bacteria thought to be beneficial to health

yoghurt: a thick, slightly sour food made from fermented milk

drink: She ordered a cold drink to cool off in the heat.
advertised: The advertised price did not include tax or delivery fees.
television: a device that receives broadcast signals and shows moving pictures with sound
The family gathered around the television to watch the final match.
dish: a particular type of food, or a container for serving food

home-made: made at home rather than bought from a shop
tự làm ở nhà, thủ công tại gia

pickled: preserved in vinegar, brine, or a similar liquid

mustard: a plant whose sharp-tasting leaves or seeds are used in food

greens: green leafy vegetables, or green areas

contain: hold something inside, or keep something within limits

part: a piece or portion of a whole

diet: the food that a person or animal usually eats

yet: The sun has set, the traffic has thinned, and yet the air refuses to cool.
lot: They spent a lot of money renovating the old house.
sugar: a sweet substance used to flavour food and drink

pickles: vegetables preserved in vinegar or brine

salt: a white crystalline substance used to season and preserve food

her: belonging to a female previously mentioned

family: a group of related people, or a group of related things

rice: the small edible grains of a staple cereal crop, or the plant itself

vegetables: plants or parts of plants used as food

beans: the seeds of certain plants, such as coffee, used as food or drink

fruit: the sweet, edible part of a plant that contains seeds

table: a flat piece of furniture with legs, used for eating or working

every: used to refer to each member of a group without exception

day: a period of twenty-four hours, or the time when it is light

probably: almost certainly; likely to be true

matter: a subject or situation being considered or discussed

either: used to refer to one or the other of two options

means: A nod usually means agreement in most cultures.
research: careful study to discover new facts

empty: The bus was almost empty at that late hour.
promising: The young researcher showed promising results in her early trials.
field: an area of open land, often used for crops or animals

eventually: in the end, especially after a long process

lead: to go in front of, guide, or result in something

new: not existing before; recently made, discovered or experienced

treatments: plural of treatment; forms of medical care

được bằng chứng ủng hộ nhiều nhất

least: Of all the options, this one costs the least money.
varied: including many different types or kinds

rich: having a lot of money or possessions

feeds: The farm feeds several hundred families in the district.
diverse: very different from each other; varied

pill: a small round tablet of medicine

promises: gives an assurance that something will happen

happier: more happy; comparative form of happy

mind: a person's thoughts, opinions, or way of thinking
